Source follow-up: Original-only blind validation. Published article title and authors match the supplied source. PDF page 5, printed p. 193, visually inspected: Experiment 4 main condition effect prints F(1,34) = 5.8, p < .05, d = 0.82. Canonical text renders equals signs as 5 (including n and the statistics); the quotation preserves those exact glyphs, while numeric meanings were verified on the rendered PDF. The n quotation uses an explicit ellipsis to omit age information and interleaved right-column text; its final segment begins with the printed line continuation signed. The supplied description mentions a table, but this matching test is reported in the Experiment 4 prose and illustrated in Figure 2. No metric conversion. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
